Name: 2050 Materials
Description:
2050 Materials is driving the future of sustainable construction with a focus on data-driven decisions. 

Our platform and API empowers professionals in the built environment to accurately evaluate environmental impacts at every stage—from design to procurement. 

By harnessing our comprehensive database and innovative data collection methods, users gain the insights needed to achieve their climate objectives efficiently. 

Register on our website for free to integrate real-time sustainability data into your projects.  Visit app.2050-materials.com

Name: Correntics
Description:
Reimagine the future - we empower organizations to weather the storm and thrive.

With our data-driven approach and a deep understanding of risk, we help our clients to future-proof their value chains and improve their resilience in the face of climate change and emerging risks while ensuring the sustainability of business activities.

Name: Tracenable
Description:
Tracenable is an open data platform that enables self-service access to traceable corporate financial and ESG data.

We combine artificial and human intelligence through our proprietary human-in-the-loop infrastructure to extract hundreds of financial and ESG metrics across thousands of global companies. These datasets are made instantly available via self-service APIs and CSV downloads. 

By offering à-la-carte data access and the industry's most permissive licensing models, we redefine how corporate information is accessed and used, reflecting our mission to foster a more transparent, accountable, and sustainable society.

Name: Riverkin
Description:
Riverkin is building the platform for freshwater data. Water drives most natural disasters, yet the data still barely exists or sits in silos. We deploy a global sensor network, aggregate fragmented sources, and turn those signals into model-ready datasets in real time. Think of it as an operating system for rivers, enabling better tools and, for the first time, the ability to predict flash floods. Already live with real deployments and paying customers.

We’re turning water into a new data layer.

Name: HYPHEN GLOBAL AG
Description:
Hyphen’s aMRV solution provides real-time quantification of GHG removals and reductions, ensuring that carbon credits and emissions claims reflect real measured impact.

Hyphen is the most accurate solution to date for capturing the real financial value of natural capital in real-time. Enabled by eddy covariance flux towers and driven by its cutting-edge, proprietary and scientifically verified digital measurement reporting and verification (dMRV) software, Hyphen offers precision quantification of GHG fluxes for verification of high quality carbon credits and emissions claims. This ensures that carbon credits are traded on the true market value of the GHGs reduced or removed. 

Hyphen wants to make carbon credits a viable and accountable financial instrument so that the true value of natural capital is not only realized but invested in. High-quality carbon credits representing measured GHG flux quantities not only benefit the buyer but also the landowner; by building a mutually beneficial bond between investor and landowner Hyphen promotes conservation and sustainable practices by incentivizing landowners to protect and improve natural ecosystems.

Name: Orizair
Description: Make every flight EU-ETS & CORSIA audit-ready with Orizair.

Name: Expertise Center for Climate Extremes (ECCE)
Description: The Expertise Center for Climate Extremes (ECCE) of the University of Lausanne is based at the Faculty of Business and Economics (HEC) and the Faculty of Geosciences and Environment (FGSE). It performs research and proposes services on the forecast of climate extremes and their impacts as well as the assessment of the risks associated with climate extremes in the current and future climates. A founding principle of ECCE is a strong interdisciplinarity, which is essential to successfully address the challenges posed by climate change.

Name: Sustainaccount
Description:
Sustainaccount empowers corporate, real estate, and infrastructure stakeholders with actionable insights to navigate and mitigate physical climate risks, enhancing the resilience of their real assets. 

Our cutting-edge software leverages advanced data analytics and AI to provide forward-looking scenario analysis, tailored adaptation strategies, and optimization pathways that consider the unique characteristics of each asset. 

By integrating climate risk assessments with key reporting frameworks like the EU Taxonomy, CSRD and DGNB we help clients de-risk their portfolios, boost asset resilience, and maintain long-term value in an evolving climate landscape.

Want to understand how exposed your assets are to climate risks and what to do about it? 
Reach out for a free demo of our Climate Resilience Suite. 

Contact us at info@sustainaccount.com
And follow us for more on climate risk, resilience, and adaptation.

Name: Resilens
Description:
Resilens is a decision engine for climate adaptation. We help public and private decision-makers turn climate risk into fundable, defensible adaptation plans, so critical places remain liveable and essential services stay functional.

We help adaptation professionals to:
- identify risk at site and portfolio level
- compare measures based on avoided damage and co-benefits
- prioritise investments and justify funding
- protect critical infrastructure and vulnerable people

We work with:
- cities and municipalities
- corporates and facility operators
- national and regional authorities
- consultancies, funders, and grant bodies

We’re hiring and currently onboarding a limited number of pilot partners.

If you manage adaptation programmes, or support those who do, let’s connect.

Name: SwissClimmo
Description:
Available datasets on climate and air quality in Switzerland are large and complex, limiting their use across the real estate sector.

SwissClimmo bridges the gap between state-of-the-art climate science and accessible insights to enhance the decisions and services of various stakeholders. 

We apply our extensive geospatial data analysis and computing skills to provide a range of high-quality and easy-to-interpret information at your address locations.

Name: WiHi
Description: WiHi is a weather and climate intelligence movement that enables improved weather forecasting including nowcasting and climate monitoring on a global scale. WiHi engages both new and existing communities of weather station operators to share their data via a common, blockchain-based platform and cryptocurrency incentive mechanisms. This is combined with WiHi's growing community of weather and climate experts, providing enhanced weather and climate intelligence to anyone, anywhere, anytime.

Name: AfriNet Wx
Description:
AfriNet is a climate technology company deploying open, low-cost weather stations across Africa, with citizens, researchers, and local institutions.
Africa is one of the most weather-vulnerable regions on earth, yet it remains one of the most underserved by ground-level climate data. AfriNet exists to close that gap. We deploy and maintain affordable weather monitoring infrastructure that generates real-time, hyper-local data where it is needed most: in farming communities, flood-prone regions, and cities navigating the frontlines of climate change.
Our stations are open by design. Data is accessible to researchers, governments, NGOs, and the communities that host them. We believe that climate resilience starts with climate visibility.
The AfriNet team came together during the deep learning indaba 2024 and won the ideathon challenge. That was the start of the AfriNet journey.

Name: Shifters auf deutsch
Description:
Diese Seite richtet sich an alle deutschsprachigen Menschen, die sich für eine nachhaltige Zukunft interessieren. Fossile Energien stellen uns vor eine doppelte Herausforderung: Sie sind nicht nur begrenzt und oft importiert, sondern verursachen auch massive Klimafolgen. Wir glauben, dass Wissen, Austausch und Zusammenarbeit entscheidend sind, um den Wandel voranzutreiben.

Auf dieser Seite teilen wir Informationen, Ideen und Lösungen rund um erneuerbare Energien, Energieeffizienz und klimafreundliche Alternativen. Unser Ziel: eine Community, die inspiriert, informiert und gemeinsam handelt. Abonniere unsere Seite, wenn du auf dem Laufenden bleiben möchtest und Teil einer Bewegung sein willst, die Verantwortung übernimmt.

Darüber hinaus suchen wir einige engagierte Freiwillige, die uns unterstützen – zum Beispiel beim Teilen von Inhalten, beim Veröffentlichen von Beiträgen oder beim Übersetzen ins Deutsche. Wenn du Lust hast, aktiv mitzuwirken, melde dich bei uns! Aber auch wenn du einfach nur informiert bleiben möchtest: Folge uns und werde Teil unseres Netzwerks. Gemeinsam können wir den Unterschied machen.

Name: JeSi - Joint Environmental Sustainability Initiative
Description:
JeSi is a pioneering environmental technology company focused on sustainable, transparent carbon offset solutions.

At JESI, our impact goals are twofold: first, to enable measurable carbon reductions by providing a platform where every contribution directly translates into real environmental change. Second, to empower users—whether individuals or organizations—to actively take part in creating a more sustainable future.

Through our technology-driven solutions, we aim to bridge the gap between intention and action, making it easier than ever for anyone to make a tangible impact on the fight against climate change.

Our target audience spans environmentally-conscious individuals, forward-thinking companies, and institutions committed to sustainability. These groups are increasingly looking for reliable, accessible, and transparent ways to offset their carbon footprint.

Name: model-it
Description:
What we do:
•	Tackling the complex nature of agricultural risk decision-making
•	Tool development, actuarial and data science
•	Understand the impact of weather patterns on your operations
•	Drive sustainability in agriculture and the environment through data-driven strategies

Name: Confluence Risk Mitigation
Description:
We are a nonprofit organization dedicated to supporting vulnerable, at-risk communities in the Global south by providing insights into their exposure to hazards and delivering actionable adaptation measures. We bridge local knowledge with data-driven insights to create sustainable solutions for communities facing climate change and natural hazards. Through active community engagement, we collect, validate, and enhance hazard risk data—empowering data-scarce regions in the Global South with the information they need to build resilience.

Leveraging our extensive flood damage dataset on sandcrete block and clay buildings, derived from multiple case studies in West Africa, we provide detailed building damage and monetary loss assessments from flood impacts. Our expertise extends to site-specific and regional flood risk assessments, utilizing advanced hydrological and hydraulic modeling to evaluate current and future risk exposure. By integrating local insights with data-driven methodologies, we deliver actionable and scalable solutions that support climate resilience.

Our network of local and international experts enables us to develop customized, community-centered solutions that address unique challenges in vulnerable regions. We foster collaboration among community leaders, funders, and initiatives, ensuring that risk reduction strategies are not only well-informed but also actionable and impactful. By combining grassroots expertise with global experience, we help transform risk assessments into long-term resilience, creating safer and more sustainable futures.

We welcome partnerships and collaborations to drive innovative, data-driven solutions that mitigate climate risks and empower communities.

Name: Category7
Description:
Category7 helps companies measure, analyze, and reduce CO2 emissions from employee commuting and remote work.

We provide decision-ready insights that turn mobility data into concrete actions — enabling sustainability and HR teams to cut emissions, support flexible work, and meet climate targets with confidence.

Built for real-world use, Category7 makes employee mobility emissions transparent, measurable, and actionable.

Smarter mobility. Lower emissions.

Name: TheTootsies
Description:
**Together, we empower a more conscious, eco-friendly world!**
Our mission is to drive positive environmental change by tracking sustainability and providing individuals with the knowledge to understand the impact of their consumer choices. We make sustainability visible and measurable, fostering awareness and inspiring action through rewards.
